title: Is SpaceX's Starlink the next big threat to telecom giants?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
SpaceX connectivity revenue surged **69.5% YoY to $5.25B** in Q3 2026, dramatically outpacing traditional telecom operators:

📈 [SPCX](https://tickeron.com/stock/SPCX/) \+69.5%  
📈 [T](https://tickeron.com/stock/T/) \+7.2%  
📈 [TMUS](https://tickeron.com/stock/TMUS/) \+6.28%  
📈 [VZ](https://tickeron.com/stock/VZ/) \+2.87%

Starlink generated **$3.49B in adjusted EBITDA**, while its expansion into mobile connectivity could challenge established carriers.

⚠️ SpaceX is growing from a much smaller revenue base, but the growth gap is striking.

**Could Starlink become a serious competitor to AT&T and Verizon?**
